liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' in the Band** (3 reviews): The sandwich sequence involving Playin' and Samson is highlighted as a standout moment; The first set features interesting combinations, specifically the Playin' to Samson transition [11][14][16]
- **Eyes of the World** (3 reviews): The second set's Eyes of the World is described as fast and furious; The listener claims this is the best Eyes and Wharf Rat they have ever heard [16][19][21]
- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): The first set's Terrapin and subsequent Playin' sequence is noted as extremely well played; Terrapin is called killer, featuring great interplay between Jerry, Phil, and Keith [13][22]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): The performance of Estimated Prophet was described as thunderous and distinct from later pairings [11]
- **Samson & Delilah** (1 review): Jerry's lead in Samson is praised for being raw with no effects or processing [21]
- **Dancin' in the Street** (1 review): Dancin', Franklin's, and Sugar Mag are highlighted as sizzling moments in the show [18]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Franklin's Tower into Sugar Magnolia is described as a sweet closing for the short set [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-03-19.152612.sbd.patched.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1977-03-19.174723.sbd.master-reel.phase-repair.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 186 min [3]. Said about its sound: Terrapin Station exhibits some fluttering, though the issue is noted as not too bad [3]
- **gd77-03-19.sbd.chinacat.255.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 170 min; rated 4.56/5 by 39 [4]. Said about its sound: The recording is praised for its amazing quality and tight, creative execution; The recording is identified as a Betty Board with five-star sound quality; The Terrapin Station recording is noted to have fluttery audio quality issues [4][12][22]
- **gd1977-03-19.mtx.hansokolow.96856.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 173 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [5]. Said about its sound: The AUD source has less than great sound reproduction but captures wonderful crowd energy [5]
- **gd1977-03-19.139354.soneyecm.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 19 songs; 173 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]

## Around the show

- The double encore indicates a highly energized crowd and strong band connection that night [20]
- Many individuals converted to full deadhead status during this specific Winterland performance [20]
- First set is considered superior to the second set in this performance [11]
- These March shows are characterized as tightly executed and calm compared to the May run [14]
- The Uncle John's Band encore is ranked among the best ever, alongside St. Louis [18]
- This show is considered to blow away the performance from the previous night [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-03-19.152612.sbd.patched.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 14, 2021; source: SBD > Reel Master > DAT (44.1k) [1]
- **gd1977-03-19.174723.sbd.master-reel.phase-repair.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  October 18, 2025; source: SBD > Reel Master > DAT (44.1k) [3]. Also: Bass was out of phase on master reels, requiring stem flipping during the mixdown [3]
- **gd77-03-19.sbd.chinacat.255.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>MR>DAT>DAT>Sonic Solutions>CDR [4]
- **gd1977-03-19.mtx.hansokolow.96856.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [5]. Also: Matrix created by hansokolow in ProTools from a friend's DAT collection and SDB source; Charlie Miller suggests Rob Bertrando likely taped the whole run, though unconfirmed in etree DB [5]
- **gd1977-03-19.139354.soneyecm.ebel.flac1644**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: Sony ECM 280 ->Cassette ->DAT [6]. Also: The setlist includes a double encore of One More Saturday Night and Uncle John's Band [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1977-03-20 Winterland Arena, San Francisco, CA](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/06/grateful-dead-1977-03-20-winterland.html) [24]
